name: Slite
desc: Slite is a modern knowledge base. Create, search, update, and ask questions about your team docs.

actions.name: ask_question
actions.description: Asks a question in natural language and returns an answer drawn from your Slite docs, with sources.

actions.name: create_doc
actions.description: Creates a doc inside a parent doc or your private channel.

actions.name: fetch_sub_docs
actions.description: Returns the list of sub docs nested under a parent doc.

actions.name: replace_doc
actions.description: Replaces the entire content and/or title of a doc. Fields you leave blank are kept unchanged.

actions.name: index_askx_object
actions.description: Sends an object to be indexed by AskX for your custom source. Note: Slite has deprecated this endpoint.

actions.name: fetch_doc
actions.description: Returns a readable doc by its ID.

actions.name: search_docs
actions.description: Performs a keyword search across the docs you have access to.

actions.name: update_doc
actions.description: Updates a specific part (tile) of a doc. Fields you leave blank are kept unchanged.

actions.name: custom_api_call
actions.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
